methodology.authority: Main docs/CONTENT_LOOP.md, procedure_rev17b97a2, and rubric A/C/D/F; this is the single independent whole-batch quality web review.
methodology.coverage: All54 proposed IDs, all54 node descriptions and inflection families, all217 directed claims and every existing target sense were assessed; no sampling and no authored candidate edits.
methodology.web: Romanian live/crawled web sources were independently accessed during this review: SOR, farm/zoo education, school texts, conservation and natural-history sources, aquaculture researchers and precise bait sources. Search-indexed source text was used when a direct fetch returned an interstitial; no new DEX request was made.
methodology.morphology: Every family was checked against cached selected lexical records and cached ordinary noun-family blocks; all54 complete proposed families occur in their cached flexion blocks. DOOM3 versus DOR attribution remains explicit. Aliases are input inflections, not newly asserted synonyms.
methodology.recognition: Native fauna, ordinary farm/companion animals and primary-school marine/world fauna meet the12-year-old/school-or-culture bar. School material corroborates the less frequent woodland and aquatic names; absence or ambiguous frequency hits never reject an item.
methodology.scope: Shared guesses and useful neighbors only. No curated round, hidden-target, difficulty-band or incoming-predecessor approval is granted. The target-only C3 floor was not substituted for the content-loop4/2/2/2 graph requirements.
methodology.predicates: The existing target nodes have the intended living-animal, anatomical, plant-part, food-material or geographical senses. Pământ already participates in soil, shovel and earthworm relations. Related_to captions read truthfully from source to target; is_a captions name honest animal/bird/fish parents.
methodology.entailments: Păun/Fazan/Potârniche/Prepeliță beaks are explicit living-Aves entailments, not claims of species-specific shape/color. Morsă Arctic presence is an explicitly checked Beaufort-location inference. Aurelia, not Mnemiopsis, supports the medusa fish-larva claim. Crap/Caras captions explicitly describe bait. Șalău and Biban captions retain young/insect-larva scope.
methodology.ownership: The347-key prescreen remains intact; installed ordinary keys are310 plus two qualified canonical-label keys. Bursucul remains owned by n_v21spo_dan_petrescu. Focă remains the RObotzi robot owner and supplies no invented seal-prey edge. The six held records are absent.
methodology.resulting_batch: All54 retained concepts satisfy4–8 distinct neighbors, at least2 old-main and2 same-category, and at most2 batch neighbors. All seven dependencies from retained items end at retained researched concepts; none becomes an island or loses its floor.
methodology.independence: Reviewer quality-v1-14 did not author module, pool or items and did not inspect the other current reviewer verdict. This artifact is bound to the original frozen bytes; later exact edits or drops do not imply a second formal round.
